init_wandb_singleton: initialize a wandb singleton logger instance with config, run id, project, and entity
log_with_wandb_singleton: log a dictionary of metrics to wandb using the singleton logger with optional step and split
log_table_wandb: log a wandb table with column names and row data using the singleton logger
log_dataframe_wandb: log a pandas dataframe as a wandb table using the singleton logger
log_tensor_stats: log tensor statistics like mean, std, min, max to wandb using the log_stats convenience function
